answer: Pick: an Onyx passkey registry for vote credit. (1) A newcomer proves personhood once via liveness selfie, then binds a WebAuthn device key to a hashed credential in Onyx. (2) Every ballot is signed by that same key, and Onyx caps each person at one credit. (3) Sybils must therefore burn hardware: a second-hand Android costs $60, so 300 fake identities cost $18,000 and 45 hours of setup, while each duplicate returns only one credit. (4) Keys rotate yearly, stretching the attacker's payback horizon. Faking a crowd is like damming a canyon: one plastic cup per crack.
